351722.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. At least three technicians appear in this location's Technician Efficiency and Technician Utilization charts (they have clocked time in the period you look at).
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site use Staging Heavy Duty - 9919. Check: on the Dashboard set Technician Efficiency to Last 12 Months, click View details and open the Technician filter: it lists at least three names. If not, try the other location in the list. If no location in the list passes this check, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no location has this data.

351719.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace) with technician clocked time over the last twelve months.
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. The workplace has technician time this year where every technician's monthly Technician Utilization is 100% or less (utilization can never pass 100%, so this always holds).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site use Staging Heavy Duty - 9919. Check: on the Dashboard set Technician Utilization to Last 12 Months: it shows a percentage, not "-". If not, try the other location in the list. If no location in the list passes this check, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no location has this data.
